this-freedom: A. S. M. Hutchinson follows his bestseller If Winter Comes with this novel of modern life in the 1920s. Its characters wrestle with the era's new freedoms — changing morals, shifting roles for women, and the price of independence. Hutchinson's earnest, emotional storytelling made him one of the decade's most widely read novelists on both sides of the Atlantic.
catholic-encyclopedia-1913-absalom: A 1913 entry on Absalom — David's beautiful, rebellious son. Herman Heuser tells of his revolt and his oak-tree death. The king's grief outlived the traitor. The Bible's most pitiful rebel prince. His pillar in the King's Dale stood for centuries.
